desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 2</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>with 1 stack of</color> <color=#ffffff>Agile Switch</color> <color=#ffffffa6>created. If you have a card with</color> <color=#ffffff>Empowerment</color> <color=#ffffffa6>in your Hand, deal 3</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>instead.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Agile Switch</color>
<color=#ffd780>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>The next time you perform "Switch Character":</color> <color=#ffffffa6>This switch will be considered a</color> <color=#ffffff>Fast Action</color> <color=#ffffffa6>instead of a</color> <color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 2</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and summons</color> <color=#ffffff>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffff>When Empowerment is attached to your card</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: If there is</color> <color=#ffffff>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> <color=#ffffffa6>on your side, it gains 1 Usage, otherwise, gains 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Energy</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. (Once per Round)</color>

Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Fast Action</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>You can continue with other actions after conducting 1 Fast Action.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Only after conducting 1 Combat Action will the turn pass over to your opponent.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Combat Action</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Empowerment</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The cost of this card is changed to the corresponding number of Dice from any element.</color>
<color=#ffffff>When this card is Tune:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>The converted element type is changed to</color> <color=#ffffff>Omni Element</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Energy</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Characters must consume Energy to use their Elemental Bursts.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When characters use an Elemental Skill or a Normal Attack, they will gain 1 Energy.</color>
